description.narrative: Leaving no one behind - The Internal Displacement Solution Fund (IDSF) was established through a MoU by UNDP and UNHCR to support the Secretary General's Action Agenda on Internal Displacement,launched in 2022 as a reponse to the report of the UN High Level Panel on IDPs. The Secretary General Special Adviser on Solutions to Internal Displacement in 2023 is chairing the IDSF. The UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund Office is the Administrative Agent for the IDSF. (Reference also QZA-23/0167) The fund is supporting UN Joint Programs under the supervision of the UN Resident Coordinator’s offices in these pilot countries: Central African Republic, Chad, Colombia, Ethiopia, Iraq, Mozambique, Nigeria, Somalia, Vanuatu, and Yemen.
